forward_guidance.text: Caterpillar anticipates growth in Power Generation for both reciprocating engines and turbines, driven by increasing energy demand to support data center build-out related to cloud computing and generative AI. Oil & Gas is expected to see moderate growth in 2026 as compared to 2025.

bull_case: Caterpillar's Q1 2026 earnings exceeded expectations, indicating strong financial performance.
The company forecasts higher annual revenue, driven by growth in power equipment benefiting from AI infrastructure.
bear_case: Operating profit margin slightly decreased from 18.1% in Q1 2025 to 17.7% in Q1 2026, indicating potential cost pressures.
Unfavorable manufacturing costs due to higher tariff costs could impact future profitability.

what_to_watch.text: Monitor geopolitical events and energy prices as they could impact Caterpillar's market outlook.
Track developments in AI infrastructure and data center build-outs, as these are key growth drivers for Caterpillar's power equipment segment.
